**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement grants RadialSpark no audit, inspection or verification right over Clear Capital. Full-text searches for *audit, inspect, verify, examine, books, records, review, monitor, premises* surface nothing of that kind:

- **Section 3 (Compensation)** runs the other way — Contractor must give *us* supporting detail for its invoices ("Each invoice submitted by Contractor will provide supporting detail for the Services invoiced...").
- **Section 4 (Ownership/Acceptance)** has no right to inspect our use of the Works.
- **Section 1's** only access language obliges Contractor to comply with our computer-system security policies — favourable to us.

With no audit obligation binding the Customer at all, the position exceeds the playbook's preferred limits (once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, independent auditor, Vendor cost, no system access), so there is nothing to constrain and we should not volunteer an audit right.
